binary.build: published macOS arm64 release binary of v0.10.4 (48669ad108fa)

model.note: Every frame is real output from a live local model call; no cell is edited.

recorded: 2026-11-24, one session per width in a real PTY under tmux 24-bit truecolor, throwaway HOME and git repository, TERM=tmux-256color COLORTERM=truecolor, default approval mode (accept edits), telemetry off.
grab: tmux capture-pane -p -e, colour kept; the .ansi files are the capture as written. One live session per width; the tmux window is resized between heights for the tall receipt and cost views. 00-launch is three fresh first launches, one per width. Crops are whole-row slices of their raw frame.

frames.shows: First launch in a fresh home before a model is connected
frames.caption_sentence: Run `codewhale` in a git repository. (First launch: no model connected, no account prompt.)

frames.shows: Model picker searched for qwen3:4b: qwen3:4b from several providers, Ollama selected
frames.caption_sentence: Pick a model from any provider; one model is often offered by several.

frames.shows: Task frame 1: the prompt has been sent to qwen3:4b
frames.caption_sentence: Codewhale on qwen3:4b edits a file in your repository, asks before it runs a command, and shows you the result.

frames.caption_sentence: Codewhale on qwen3:4b edits a file in your repository, asks before it runs a command, and shows you the result.
